title: A2UI catalog kyberion-base
description: Props contract for the shared kyberion-base A2UI component catalog (UI-01). Validates one component {id?, type, props, children?}; $defs['props:<type>'] is the props schema for each ui:* type. Legacy aliases (text/button/card/container) and display:*/kb-*/presence.* types are outside this catalog.

href.description: Navigation target. javascript: and data: URLs are rejected.

action.description: Surface-dispatched action (the renderer routes it; never evaluated as code).

status.description: Canonical dashboard status vocabulary (libs/core/ux-vocabulary.ts renderStatus domains).

action-ref.description: A labelled link or action. Exactly one of href / action.

action.description: Surface-dispatched action, or just its id (no payload).

table-cell.description: ui:table cell: a scalar, or a rich cell — {title, id?, href?} (title with a mono id line), {status, label?, domain?} (status pill) or {badge, tone?} (badge).

props:ui:app-shell.description: Page skeleton. Children: nav-rail, page-header, main content.

brand.description: Brand slot at the top of the rail: product / surface name, optional subtitle and logo image (a token-colored mark when no logo).

context.description: Context block (tenant / workspace being viewed). options + action = switcher (action payload gets { value }); action alone = button; href alone = link.

variant.description: primary (default) = underlined page tabs; secondary = pill-style sub-navigation.

columns.description: Fixed column count; omit for auto-fit.

props:ui:next-action.description: The single most important next step. primary is required unless state is loading or empty.

status_label.description: Visible status pill text (default: the localized status label).

progress.description: Percent complete, drawn as a small meter with accessible text.

props:ui:code.description: Monospace code / log block (white-space: pre-wrap). No syntax highlighting; the text is never interpreted.

props:ui:status-pill.description: Icon + text status indicator; never color-only.

target.description: Link target, only meaningful with href. _blank always gets rel="noopener".

props:ui:display-controls.description: Viewer display preferences: theme (system / light / dark) segmented control + language select. Dispatches display.theme / display.locale with { value }; the host persists.

field-name.description: Field key reported in field.change / action payloads.

file-entry.description: Metadata of one selected file. File contents are never props.

props:ui:settings-group.description: Titled group of settings. Children: ui:setting-row (or any component).

props:ui:setting-row.description: One setting: label + description on the left, one control (child) on the right.

props:ui:switch.description: On/off toggle (role=switch). Edits dispatch field.change {name, value}.

props:ui:segmented.description: Small exclusive choice rendered as a segmented radio group.

props:ui:integration-item.description: External connection status (connected / needs re-auth / disconnected / error) with actions.

props:ui:file-drop.description: Drag & drop / click / paste file picker. Selected files reach the host only as the onAction payload; `files` lists metadata the host tracks (progress, errors).

props:ui:camera-capture.description: Camera photo capture started by an explicit user action; falls back to a file input. The photo reaches the host only as the onAction payload.

props:ui:avatar-picker.description: Current avatar + upload / take photo / remove with a square crop preview. Images reach the host only as the onAction payload.

props:ui:secret-field.description: Secret (API token) input. There is deliberately no `value` prop: a stored secret is never sent to the page, only `configured` + `last4`. The typed value reaches the host only in the submit action payload.

status.description: Host-reported outcome of the last submit. The field reads 'sending' after a submit until the host sets saved or error; it never reports success on its own. error reopens the input.

status_error.description: Host-localized reason shown instead of the generic error text when status is error.

props:ui:bar-chart.description: UI-01b: grouped / stacked bars, vertical or horizontal. `series` + `categories`, or the single-series `data` shorthand (chronos display:bar-chart compatible).

props:ui:line-chart.description: UI-01b: time series as lines (or areas). `x` is a label (point scale) or a number (linear scale).

props:ui:donut.description: UI-01b: part-to-whole ring; more than 8 segments fold into Other. `data` is the chronos display:donut shorthand.

props:ui:heatmap.description: UI-01b: density grid (e.g. weekday x hour). Sequential scale by default; `diverging` centres on `midpoint` (default 0).

props:ui:meter.description: UI-01b: usage against a limit. The tone is the highest threshold at or below `value`; it is shown with a glyph and a state word, never color alone.

direction.description: lower_is_better (default; usage against a limit) or higher_is_better (rates such as completion). Only the state words change; the tone is always the highest threshold at or below value.

props:ui:sequence.description: UI-01b: message flow between participant lanes over time. `kind: reply` draws a dashed arrow; from === to is a self-message; `status` adds a status glyph + label.

props:ui:flow.description: UI-01b: staged DAG (mission -> tasks -> agents). Layers are `stage`s when every node has one, else longest-path layers; ordering is deterministic.
